On this space station, fizzy drinks are illegal.
Even the birthday cake has to be flat.
Nobody tells the new cook why. They just point up.
I'm Gus, the cook, and I love a party.
So I smuggled in forty cans of cola.
The whole crew cheered, and everybody drank.
But then the captain leaned back, took a deep breath, and burped.
And the ceiling got a very strange new color.
The captain just stared up at it.
Then the engineer. Then the doctor. Then everyone, like a choir.
Here's why: in space, gas and food don't separate in your stomach, so a burp brings dinner with it.
So the crew wiped the ceiling all night, with toothbrushes.
Now I serve flat water. And rule one: no soda. Ever.
